description: This file is a unit test class for the HolidayDao component within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It contains multiple test methods verifying the functionality of retrieving, saving, searching, and deleting holiday records via the HolidayDao data access object.

classes.name: HolidayDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the behavior of HolidayDao methods within the leave plugin, including retrieval, persistence, search filtering, and deletion of holiday entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case by creating an instance of HolidayDao and populating test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testGetHolidayById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a holiday record by its ID and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testSaveHoliday
methods.description: Tests saving an existing holiday object and verifies that the stored data matches the input.

methods.name: testSaveHolidayWithNoId
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new holiday without an initial ID and verifies that an ID is assigned.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysWithoutFromToDates
methods.description: Tests searching for holidays without date filters, expecting all holidays with default filters.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysWithoutFromToDatesAndExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Tests searching for holidays with exclusion of recurring holidays.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysWithoutFromDateAndExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Tests searching with only an end date filter and excluding recurring holidays.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysWithoutToDateAndExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Tests searching with only a start date filter and excluding recurring holidays.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Tests comprehensive date range search with exclusion of recurring holidays and validates expected results.

methods.name: testSearchHolidays
methods.description: Tests searching holidays within a date range and verifies the returned list contents.

methods.name: testGetHolidayByDate
methods.description: Tests fetching holidays by specific date and checks for correct holiday name matches.

methods.name: testDeleteHolidays
methods.description: Tests deleting multiple holidays by their IDs and verifies the number of deletions processed.
